title: The FOUNDER_LOGS_JSON seam masks the ENTIRE real getLogs parse path: from-topic slice, value BigInt decode, topics ordering, and fromBlock/toBlock are NEVER exercised — a bug in any of them passes all 12 tests
description: All 12 behavioral cases feed pre-parsed logs via FOUNDER_LOGS_JSON='[{from,value}]' (test-record-earn.sh:34,39,44,...). When that seam is set, externalInflow short-circuits at record-earn.mjs:70-71 and returns JSON.parse(logsSeam) WITHOUT ever building toTopic, calling eth_getLogs, mapping topics[1].slice(26) to `from`, or decoding Number(BigInt(l.data))/1e6 to `value` (the entire else-branch, lines 72-76, is dead under test). The seam also returns the same logs REGARDLESS of fromBlock/toBlock — so the off-by-one of the real scan window (fromBlock='0x'+(cursor+1).toString(16), toBlock='0x'+now.toString(16)) and the topics filter ordering [TRANSFER_TOPIC, null, toTopic] are never verified by any test (grep topics|slice|getLogs|0xddf252|BigInt in test = ZERO matches). Consequences that would PASS green today: (a) a wrong slice offset (e.g. slice(24) or slice(26) off by a nibble) would mis-extract `from`, breaking the self-vs-external classification — the very heart of INV-7/THE GOAL — yet every self-transfer test passes because it never runs the slice; (b) a wrong topics index (filtering on `from` instead of `to`, or omitting the address pin) would let Transfers to OTHER wallets or non-USDC tokens be summed, and no test would catch it; (c) a wrong value decimal (1e6 vs 1e18) is untested. The seam is a legitimate I/O boundary, but the PARSE of the RPC response is pure logic that MUST be unit-tested directly.
fix: Move the seam DOWN to the raw-log level so the parse is exercised. Add a FOUNDER_RAWLOGS_JSON test seam that injects an array of REAL-SHAPED logs ({topics:[TRANSFER_TOPIC, fromTopic, toTopic], data:'0x...'}) BEFORE the .map() at line 76, and route FOUNDER_LOGS_JSON's behavior through the same map. Then add cases: (i) a real-shaped external log with a 32-byte padded `from` topic asserts from-extraction yields the correct 20-byte address and value=BigInt(data)/1e6; (ii) a real-shaped SELF log (from-topic = padded automaton wallet) asserts it is filtered; (iii) a 0-value Transfer (data='0x0') asserts 0 contribution; (iv) a malformed topic/short data asserts fail-closed. Keep at least one case that drives the actual fromBlock/toBlock hex construction (e.g. assert getLogs is called with the expected hex range via a recording stub).
